name: proveml-paper1-review
description: The Vera review of ProveML paper 1: the build, its adapters, and the records that make the page reproducible.

scripts.infer: node build.mjs && node infer-cli.mjs && node build.mjs
scripts.push: node ${VERA_HOME:-$HOME/Projects/vera}/skill/cli.mjs push paper1 report/review-page-vera.html --instance prod --by hello@shanedeconinck.be --title "ProveML: Inline Claim Markup for Deterministic Verification of AI-Generated Text"
scripts.build:artifact: node build.mjs && node artifact-gate.mjs report/review-page.html && node stream-infer.mjs report/review-page-artifact.html
scripts.anchor: node anchor-hedera.mjs && node anchor-rekor.mjs && node anchor-vana.mjs
scripts.verify: node anchor-hedera.mjs --verify && node anchor-rekor.mjs --verify && node anchor-vana.mjs --verify && node sign-review.mjs --verify
